title: Back To Beta!
description: A well-performing, lightweight modpack tailored for the server "Modern Beta"
body:
# This modpack is lightweight, and not very visually obstructive.

## **Please Disable Hotbar Buffering in Exordium.**

**This modpack is tailored toward the server** "**_Modern Beta_**" but _can_ be used if your just a beta fanatic. It adds lots of QOL mods, without lagging or being visually obstructive.

**However**, this is **_not_** a pure performance modpack. **It features many QOL mods**, if you want pure performance, use [Thunderbolt](https://modrinth.com/modpack/thunderbolt), my other modpack.

**Happy Modern Beta-ing**!
